messages:
Maya (support): Customer reports sustained p95 timeouts and a surge of 502/504s from the rerank endpoint during a 10k-QPS simulation. They say error rates jump ~12% and requests get retried heavily, causing gateway timeouts. Attached their request id: req_6b9f2c.
Eli (sre): Can you paste the sample request + headers (sanitized)? especially batch size, candidate count, and region. Also which model variant are they hitting?
Maya (support): payload snippet: ```{
  "queries": ["ctx..."],
  "candidates": [....] // ~800 per query
  "max_candidates": 800,
  "batch_size": 64,
  "concurrency": 48
}``` They call us from us-west-2. Model pinned to rwdn/rerank-v3-16k. Auth and billing look fine.
Ashok (infra): 48 concurrency + 64 batch = heavy KV/attention memory pressure. Gateway will fan out to many backend workers. Do they use prefix KV cache or kvcache_prefetch?
Maya (support): Customer said they enabled kvcache_prefetch: true to speed things up.
Jordan (runtime): That combination can cause large memory footprints per request — if many candidates, KV cache lines per candidate explode. We've seen p95 spikes when candidate_count * batch_size * concurrency crosses a threshold.
Eli (sre): Requesting traces for req_6b9f2c and a few adjacent request ids. Also need gateway logs for 502s and backend container OOM / eviction events. @OpsBot can you fetch recent 502 trace for us-west-2 for that time window?
OpsBot: Fetching logs for req_6b9f2c... found traces: gateway 502->backend 504 timeout at 2026-03-15T17:12:31Z, backend reported inference queue depth high, no OOMs recorded but GC latency increased.
Ashok (infra): If GC latency increased without OOM, likely long tail allocations (large tensors) plus stop-the-world. What was the quantization profile (fp16/q4)?
Maya (support): They were using q4_0.
Jordan (runtime): q4_0 + very large candidate sets is known to push kernel selection into slower code paths for some transformer layers — increases latency per token. Combined with large batch/concurrency it overshoots our latency SLO and gateway retries pile up.
Eli (sre): Short mitigation steps for customer: 1) Reduce batch_size to 8-16. 2) Limit concurrency (in their client) to ~8. 3) Cap max_candidates to 200 and test. 4) Disable kvcache_prefetch for now. 5) Use the smaller rerank variant rwdn/rerank-v3-8k if quality acceptable.
Maya (support): I suggested those to the customer and asked for a controlled repro plan. They want a script we can provide to reproduce locally so we can confirm.
Jordan (runtime): Copy this minimal repro load command (use our loadgen image):
```bash
docker run --rm loadgen:latest \
  --endpoint https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  --api-key REDACTED \
  --concurrency 8 \
  --batch-size 16 \
  --candidates 200 \
  --qps 2000 \
  --duration 5m
```
Replace with real key and point to their region.
Eli (sre): Also enable endpoint tracing by adding header `x-redwood-trace: true` so we can correlate. If they see timeouts after mitigation, capture `X-Request-Id` values and forward.
Ashok (infra): Longer-term: add a routing policy to prefer smaller batch kernels for rerank or autoscale backends based on candidate_count heuristics. Filing infra follow-up.
Maya (support): Customer will try the mitigations and run the script. I'll post results + any X-Request-Id values. Thanks all :thumbsup:
